hypothesis: M185 and M186 show that the 1024-step guarded PPO smoke recipe can preserve behavior, protected key, and M183 replay surfaces across independent seeds. A single short staged extension from the best retained fixed-loss checkpoint may advance the policy without washing out the proof rows.
success_criteria: start from runs/ppo_m185_guarded_from_m184_seed5185/checkpoint.pt because it is the lowest fixed-loss retained checkpoint
run only one short staged PPO extension before any longer training
keep M184 or M185 as a strong action anchor
keep actor inputs unchanged and do not expose M183 labels or hidden dynamics
preserve behavior success on seeds 9503 and 9504
preserve M168 and M170 M183 boundary replay success-drop counts
reject the stage if replay or behavior regresses even if fixed objective improves
failure_criteria: run a long PPO continuation directly
drop any M183 boundary replay success-drop row
promote based on fixed objective improvement alone

commands.name: m187_short_stage2
commands.command: Run a 1024-step staged PPO extension from runs/ppo_m185_guarded_from_m184_seed5185/checkpoint.pt with strong action anchoring and the same M183 outcome auxiliary objective.

commands.name: m187_post_stage_gates
commands.command: Repeat M185/M186 fixed objective, behavior, protected-key, and M168/M170 M183 boundary replay gates on the stage2 candidate.

decision_rule: Admit further staged PPO only if the short stage2 candidate preserves behavior, protected key, and both M183 replay surfaces.
